remarks: Welcome to resort-style living in Corona’s desirable Sierra del Oro community! This beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom upstairs condominium offers an inviting combination of comfort, convenience, and low-maintenance living. The bright and spacious living area features abundant natural light, fresh interior paint, and premium carpeting throughout. The kitchen is appointed with granite countertops, while both generously sized bedrooms feature ceiling fans. The primary suite includes a spacious walk-in closet with a built-in organizer, providing additional storage and functionality.
